root.label: South Korea dog farm animal disposition December 2025

events.label: South Korea dog farm animal disposition December 2025

slots.name: dogs on closed farms
slots.sentence: Of nearly 394,000 dogs recorded on farms that had closed by December 2025, only about 1,100 were adopted or transferred to public shelters, local media reports citing government data said.

slots.name: dogs adopted shelters
slots.sentence: only about 1,100 were adopted or transferred to public shelters

slots.name: dogs transferred farms
slots.sentence: about 9,400 were transferred to other farms.

slots.name: slaughter or distribution rate
slots.sentence: Roughly 97% were sent for slaughter or distribution, while about 9,400 were transferred to other farms.
